messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild that drops privileged bits, moves workloads into ephemeral namespaces, and swaps the KMS signer role to the new keystore. Targeting next Wed maintenance window. Any blockers?

sanjay: Ack. Couple of things:
- RBAC: service accounts that were using cluster-admin via legacy rolebindings will need scoped bindings.
- Runtime: we should test userns remap + rootless containers; some sidecars assume root.

kevin: KMS note — the new signer key is in the HSM-backed keyring. Rotation requires updating the cosign config on the signing worker pool and the image verification policy. I can prepare a migration script.

carmen: Audit logging ask: when we switch signer keys we also need immutable audit entries linking old -> new key IDs. Cloud audit needs to capture: signer-key-id, image-digest, build-id, and who triggered the sign. Retention policy? 1 year minimum for compliance.

maria: @kevin can you drop the migration script here + a dry-run command? @carmen I'll file the retention policy with Legal but we need the logs to be searchable (json payload).

kevin: put this in the repo under infra/signing/migrate_signer.sh (draft):

```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
OLD_KEY=$1
NEW_KEY=$2
# export cosign env
COSIGN_KMS_URI=awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/$NEW_KEY
export COSIGN\\
# dry run: check signed images still verify with old key
for img in $(cat canary-images.txt); do
  cosign verify --key $OLD_KEY $img || echo "verify-failed $img"
 done
# update signer pod deployment to use NEW_KEY via secret
kubectl set env deploy/signer SIGNER_KMS_URI=$COSIGN_KMS_URI --namespace signing
```

kevin: (will add proper error handling, creation of signed mapping file)

security-oncall: From incident posture — if images fail verification after cutover, fallback plan must exist. Two options:
1) Automatic fallback in the admission controller: accept images signed by either key for 1 hour post-cutover.
2) Rollback to previous image digest if verification fails at runtime.
We prefer 1 for availability, but we need strict audit for any exception.

maria: Good call. Can we implement 1 as a canary for the signing admission controller? Maybe a feature-flagged window param.

carmen: For RBAC changes, list of service accounts to audit:
- build/builder-sa
- deploy/kaniko-sa
- signing/signer-sa
- infra/registry-sync-sa
I'll run a quick membership dump and post the current rolebindings. Expect some manual changes for kaniko (needs write to registry).

sanjay: Also be mindful of node-level privileges: setcap and suid bits on runtime layers must be removed or replaced with CAP_xxx capabilities granted via the scheduler (KubePodSecurityPolicy or PSP successor). We should add an automated scan to our image pipeline to detect suid/sgid.

devops-bot: Created ticket: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 — "privsep namespace + signer rotation: coordination" — assignees: @kevin, @carmen, @sanjay. Milestone: image-hardening-sprint-2.

kevin: I'll add a canary job that signs images with both old and new keys and pushes to the canary repo. Admission controller change on staging: accept both keys while flag enabled.

maria: Timeline:
- Tue: RBAC binding audit + changes merged
- Wed AM: canary signer rotation + admission controller flag enabled in staging
- Wed evening: prod cutover in maintenance window
- Thu morning: follow-up verification + rollback window closed

security-oncall: During the window, paging rules should be lowered for verification failures — add on-call alert if >5 verification failures in 5m. Also capture stack traces and pod names in the audit payload.

carmen: One more compliance note: we need SBOMs for each image in the canary set (CycloneDX). Attach SBOM artifact link to the audit log entry.

maria: Agreed. Action items:
- @kevin: draft migration + canary script, run dry run by Tue EOD
- @carmen: rolebinding changes + audit retention and SBOM hook by Tue EOD
- @sanjay: image scan rule for suid/sgid and test userns remap on canaries
- @security-oncall: update alert and fallback runbook (short doc)

sanjay: Quick Q: for userns remap testing, anyone on call to triage sidecar breakage tomorrow afternoon? I can be available 2–4pm.

kevin: I can help 2–3pm.

maria: Great — I'll schedule the slot and post the runbook link here once created.

devops-bot: Note: staging admission controller PR created — https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 (wip).

maria: Thanks all. Let's keep channel updates limited to major changes; use the ticket for granular diffs. :thumbsup:
